name: Cocoanut Pudding No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: grated cocoanut
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of grated cocoanut

ingredients.name: stale sponge cake, crumbled fine
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of stale sponge cake, crumbled fine

ingredients.name: a coffee cupful of rich milk or cream
ingredients.originalText: a coffee cupful of rich milk or cream
ingredients.quantityText: a coffee cupful of rich milk or cream

instructions.text: Mix the grated cocoanut with half a cupful of stale sponge cake, crumbled fine
Stir together until very light half a cupful of butter and one cupful of sugar
Add a coffee cupful of rich milk or cream
Beat six eggs very light and stir them gradually into the butter and sugar in turn, with the grated cocoanut
Having stirred the whole very hard, add two teaspoonfuls of vanilla
Stir again, put into a buttered dish and bake until set, or about three-quarters of an hour

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix the grated cocoanut with half a cupful of stale sponge cake, crumbled fine
2. Stir together until very light half a cupful of butter and one cupful of sugar
3. Add a coffee cupful of rich milk or cream
4. Beat six eggs very light and stir them gradually into the butter and sugar in turn, with the grated cocoanut
5. Having stirred the whole very hard, add two teaspoonfuls of vanilla
6. Stir again, put into a buttered dish and bake until set, or about three-quarters of an hour
